notes.title: A Tale Told by the Victor: Pride
notes.content:
Hey, travelers!
As Rose’s journey continues, we leave Gluttony’s ravenous realm and enter the Mirrorverse of Pride. 

Don’t trust what you see here, travelers. Just like in the tale told by the victor — there is a lot of fact twisting and pompous self-glorification here.

The Shogun
Once a powerful Shogun – who conquered lands in the name of honor and glory – the Pride clutches the Realm in his ephemeral grip. He uses his influence to show himself as the only hero in his story. And there is no one in the realm to challenge him over it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/9c5c2b8167a8feb7b65a8e3db3ba3a1707ab701e.png
You might think that he’s all talk, but all who thought the same way never won the duel with the ex-Shogun. Even in the afterlife, the Pride is as masterful of a swordsman as he was in life. 

To keep his distance in a fight he uses myriad of blades, dotted across the arena and doesn’t shy away from petty, underhanded tactics. If not taken seriously enough, the battle will be over in a blink of an eye.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/69e3e321b3265d3f30561ab5dcbaf73c2a872542.png
And The Pride will never miss an opportunity to play on your egos and insecurities to lull your vigilance.

Twisted Epos
The realm of Pride depicts a surreal and highly subjective version of feudal Japan during the Samurai era. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/242285074fb12be100051bd4ccee89ac2abff999.png
In life the Pride – like most other warlords – sacrificed other’s lives for his reputation and standing. And the realm stands as a silent reminder of what unsatisfiable ambitions lead to. Abandoned ruins and destroyed temples, ghost towns and green overgrowth. Each one shows the end result of a bloody feud over power.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/83bd0e60e2e1a2203451b77a2034212fa8a59fcb.png
As you go deeper into the realm, more and more echoes of the Pride’s conquest will appear to thwart your progress. From burning buildings to confusing labyrinths. From deadly arrow traps to hordes of undead warriors. Everything plays its dedicated role in the Pride’s twisted epos.

Ukiyo-e
Pushing through the domain of Pride is like making your way through the desolated wastelands of unfulfilled ambitions. Here the stale suffocating grays are peppered with the ghostly shades of greens.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/490d6a373357e9e1d938cb3e0a417cc462ad71fd.png
The further you go and the closer you get to the Pride, the more vivid and saturated the surroundings become. Freakish pinks mix with delicate deep-blues; saturated crimson adjoins abyssal blacks. And together it creates an almost Ukiyo-e style experience. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/c005dd4488b7076538099609b10295244cca43f0.png
In the end, the Pride’s realm — just like all the others we’ve visited so far, — is a tale as old as human society itself. After all, the Sins are primal and simple by their nature. But this realm tries to make it seem as if you are at the wrong for challenging someone as grandiose as the Shogun. And yet, the evil of concealing the truth is, arguably, worse than the deeds committed. This epos is well past due to receive it’s conclusion. And there will be nothing worthy of pride, when Rose puts a final dot its the end.

And now, travelers, – after visiting the realms of Wrath, Sloth, Gluttony and Pride, – will you still be brave enough to gallop through the Underwest with Rose? To witness, what will it take the mother to save her daughter? To find out, what Sins will become the next obstruction of vengeance? To uncover, what do the other realms hide?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1697850/Rose_and_Locket/

Embrace the story by wishlisting the game and joining Rose’s path of vengeance. 

Until next time, travelers!

notes.title: All-encompassing Voracity: Gluttony
notes.content:
Hey, travelers!

We continue to gallop through the Underwest, following Rose’s steps on her path of vengeance. After we’ve explored the realms of the Wrath and Sloth, the road takes us through that of boundless famishment.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/c9de9b7d20be33bf6510775771b9f74201716c29.jpg

This is a realm characterized by its insatiable hunger and gluttonous nature. Acidic lakes, vulturous dwellers, and aggressively carnivorous nature — this is the ravenous domain of the Gluttony.

The Kingdom of All-Engrossing Famishment

The realm belongs to the evergrowing Forest that mutates every soul, damned enough to wind up there. A little note for you, travelers: once you give in to the fear of hunger, you will never be the same again.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/4d1b17d6f88ee3193f56ae7ebf153a1938c46647.jpg

The Forest’s only purpose of existence is to consume, transform and mutate any unfortunate soul into another thrall for the Sin’s hordes. Even the Lost Ones, – the smallest and most innocent spirits of the Underwest, – are doomed to this transfiguration in the endless labyrinth of Gluttony. No soul is safe, no soul is unnoticed, no soul is free from the Sin’s enduring clutch.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/8f2921003b488b86f508418af3103dac3d073c7a.png

The dangers of the Forest wary from bottomless pits and treacherous landscapes to scaling waterfalls and acidic cavities. Mind your every jump, calculate your every shot, watch your every step: even the smallest slip up will turn you into compost.

Colours of Decay

The domain of Gluttony will meet you with the murkiness of decay. Acid green and purple, rotten gray and black, fading yellow and brown are the colors that dominate the realm.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/49880e9893818cf38061876a4ab47fbae6435aa2.jpg

A complete one-eighty from the dew of the Sloth, isn’t it? The sense of mustiness and staleness will drown every breath you take.

The Venus Flytrap

The Forest itself is Gluttony. The Sin, – which took the form of a carnivorous plant, – is sitting atop of the acid-washed timber, spreading the pestilence of hunger, consumption and mutation onto every unlucky dweller.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/5c1923fc662ec1f07fff79a14fb13688c0bfb244.jpg

While attempting to claim the bounty don’t let the Gluttony’s appearance fool you, travelers. Despite being a plant he’s a formidable foe: cautious, cunning and well-prepared to counter-attack any uninvited guest. Even the Gluttony’s body seems to be just unreachable — surrounded by innumerable thralls, deadly traps and disfigured vegetation herself. 

There are yet more secrets of the Underwest to uncover. Will Rose be able to save her daughter? What kind of Sins will she meet next? What do the other realms look like?

notes.title: Death in the emptiness: Sloth
notes.content:
Hey, travelers!

As we follow Rose along her path of vengeance, we delve deeper into the Underwest. After we already explored the realm of Wrath, our route now takes us through a rather peculiar expanse — nothingness.

It is a realm characterized by its sheer emptiness. Devoid of colors, sounds, and emotions – this desolate domain belongs to Sloth.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/c1c66e8c6820ef76e228d2dc78e40551f1797eef.png


Absolute Kingdom of the Silence

Sloth radiates a luminous white glow, drawing inspiration from the dusty, neglected places of yesteryear. This place embodies sheer emptiness. And what conveys the vastness without being boring and inexpressive? Clouds of course!

A realm in ruins where the only purpose is to glide through as if floating aimlessly through life without passion. Drifting in-between these cloudscapes feels futile — a journey through realms devoid of meaning. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/8c7bb4ff0a013303b3bf42da529e7fbe7134968e.png

If someone enters the Sloth realm — and it’s unlikely that anyone alive will dare — all that awaits them is an endless fall into a colorless abyss. A little tip from the Travel guide: some travelers use coffins as means of traversal, take note.

Crumbling fortresses, skeletons of cities or abandoned houses of the long dead — no one can say what these ruins were. All that awaits them is desolation and oblivion as their last remembrance fades away in the lands of inaction.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/26e7503f1787f8ad8f37e36bd62c07c4fa74925a.png

Colors of nothingness

The colors here are pastel whites and blues, scattered among forgotten ruins, creating an airy atmosphere.

It's a sharp change from the fiery and energetic realm of Wrath, overflowing with emotions. Think of it as a break! Moving from the aftermath of Wrath to the eerie stagnant air of Sloth.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/b3f5d93491ed2f6b25a2e641c6263e07d127c87e.png

What is Sloth itself like? The emptiness can look like anything, but Sloth chooses the most fitting appearance. The swirling clouds take on vague outlines. But it's hard to make complete sense of what's it supposed to be.

However, an encounter with him can result in no less danger than that of the fire Sin. Imagine fighting in free fall without the slightest fulcrum.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/fe6e17dd78fe7b4efc336275e82b63522a6dea23.png

Everything enters and exits in a void here. But how will Rose transform as she leaves Sloth's domain? And which Sin will she encounter next on her journey?

Join us next time for another chapter of the Underwest Travel Guide, where we'll tell you more about the Lands of Death

Until next time, Travelers!

notes.title: Blood and fire: Wrath
notes.content:
Hey, travelers!

We continue our Underwest Travel Guide. Here the Lands of Death are divided by Seven Sins each with its own patrimony. Each patrimony is an embodiment of the Sin which controls it. Emotions, colors, sounds — all this matters in the world of Underwest.

Today we'll be visiting the first domain Rose encountered on her journey. The land of horror, hopelessness and despair the blood-red Sin of Wrath, crimson in hue stands supreme.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/354d6d75d11153f6e1f7be4155ac5df6ed8484a1.png

Spectral ghost town: Wrath and its domain

The dominion of Wrath is an old abandoned town inspired by the classic Wild West settlements of the American frontier. But the music no longer plays at the saloon, and the clock on the town tower has stopped forever at noon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/4249965eb26efa998be8a8459058de933570a8b8.png

It is a place of teeming rage where red dominates the color palette. All shades — from rust to blood — embody aggression, violence and cruelty.

Wrath flits through the mass graves of the Underworld, gathering The Lost Ones. Who knows what Wrath does with these frail souls gone astray?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/7043e373fcd0c282cfb32b3c5a91f1a282083985.png
Endless firefight

Wrath is a classic Western villain. The thirst for blood defines his entire life (or afterlife?). Wrath is one of those who always shoots first, and asks questions later.

The embodiment of pure primordial rage, he is brutal and completely devoid of composure. His Ego blinds him, making him irrational.

He wields flames, scorching red, just like him. He's cathartic about setting his enemies on fire — ending their existence in one of the most painful ways by using fireballs like bullets.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/354d6d75d11153f6e1f7be4155ac5df6ed8484a1.png
Red. Blood red

Color in the world of Underwest is a key element that not only conveys the emotion of each of the Sins, but also contributes heavily to the atmosphere of the Underworld

The colors of the Wrath lands are red. This color dominates not only the location and visual design, but also all of Wrath’s dialogues. All his words seem to ooze with rage, unable to contain the hatred for all things living.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/d4819493cad8310a5349fd1bcd9f91cad2db56d8.png
“I can feel your blood boiling, Rose”

The lands of the Underwest are fraught with many dangers. And meeting each Sin is a test on the verge of life and death.

Get ready, our journey through the cruel and dark lands of the Underwest is just beginning! What is the next sin that will intercept Rose from saving her daughter? In the next devlog we will talk more about another Sin! What will Sloth be like in Rose history?

Until next time, Travelers!

notes.title: Underwest Travel Guide
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/4d4c8f2096a96b8006fe2268ad1c49e3f2c971f0.png

Hello Travelers! 

Welcome to our Underwest Travel Guide, this time we're diving straight into the realm of the dead, —  the Underwest. A pivotal place where Rose fights to save her daughter, the only thing that can be dear to a hardened gunslinger like herself. 

The Underworld is a wicked and mysterious place. The Seven Sins reign supreme  and danger lurks behind every turn. Let’s get into it and take a closer look at the secrets, designs, creatures, and emotions that bring this atmospheric realm to life! 

The Underwest’'s Creation: Emotion and Color

The Underwest is a canvas splashed with pigments that convey explicit meanings. This is the domain of the Seven Sins, each one embodying the idea and emotion behind one of these vibrant colors. 
The nature of every Sin is represented by their signature colors. For instance, Wrath's domain is violent  red. — A color long-associated with intense anger, fierceness, and passion. Or Sloth’s domain which is an ephemeral and airy blue  — symbolizing laziness and indifference, a realm where its hues obscure everything and make it nearly impossible to keep track of time. Gluttony’s world is a suffocating green, consumed by dense forests — a place as beautiful as it is dangerous where verdant tones dominate, long associated with abundance and growth.  
The intricate link between the colors and the emotions they evoke was for our choice of the palettes for the Sins. Every color you see was deliberately chosen to represent the capital vices in their respective realms.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/81dbfad0418d274df1eba8738e483c7405238cc3.png

Land of the Dead

In the Underworld, life is but a distant memory. No one truly "lives" here — it's the realm where souls of the dead go to atone. Overseen by the Grand Sins, it's a realm stuck in limbo, occupying the space between life and the afterlife. 
The Grand Sins reign supreme here, each of them controlling a section of this desolate realm. This world is nightmarish and twisted. But the Grand Sins are not the only threat in this world. There are other dangers lurking in the shadows, each and every one of them waiting to prey on unsuspecting hapless souls.
As Rose travels deeper into the heart of the Underwest she will be confronted by hordes of  apparitions — grotesque minions born from the colossal plant-like sin, Gluttony. 

The Vibes of the Underwest

Which word can be used to describe the Underwest? Atmospheric.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/d404ec8281d1bc5a405157a9efc3d571a9343c6c.png

Every corner of the Underwest roils with an unsettling energy. It has a chilling atmosphere that wraps around you, sinking down through your bones and into your very soul. Every plane oozes the very essence of the Seven Sins, every corner of the Underwest is under their absolute power, leaving nowhere for you to hide. 

Dwellers from the Underwest 

The monsters of 'Rose & Locket' borrow a bit of their design philosophy from classic '90s shooters like Doom and Doom 2. All enemies have a specific visual design to help players single out threats amidst the chaos of combat. With many spirit-like foes, expect enemies to come from all directions, even from above, making every encounter a thrilling challenge.

Friendly souls in the Underwest?

The Underwest is a wild and dangerous realm, especially for unwelcome guests. 
With the exception of the innocent ‘Lost Ones’ — glowing white spirits, it's a barren and hostile land under the ruthless control of the Sins. Rose will be able to meet the Lost Ones — gaining the favor of the only friendly phantoms in this hazardous world of the Underwest.  

Every step taken in the Underwest is a dance with danger, and Rose must navigate it with her lightning-quick reflexes and deadly arsenal of weapons.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/67c33959290f1ba35a1e129ebe04c7e4f6c6e543.png

Prepare to venture deeper into the world of Rose & Locket — in our next devlog we’ll introduce you to each Grand Sin and the plains under their jurisdiction, starting with Wrath???

Until next time, Travelers!

notes.title: A Big Iron on Her Hip
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/74ae9b80412b93c3608eb9aabfe079d454f9d31c.png

Devlog #2: Meet Rose - The heart and soul of Rose and Locket


Hello everyone! 
As you may have gathered from the title of this devlog, Rose is the main character of our game:  Rose and Locket!

This is our second devlog so today we'd like to introduce her in detail, and let you all get to know a little more about the woman behind the title. We hope her unique design, personality, and role within the game’s world will capture your imagination and make you eager to learn more about her.

Let’s get into it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/4d879d40d1880122629d20f3f89eed3081e463ec.png


The inspiration behind Rose’s style 

Rose, the main hero of the game, has a unique but familiar design. It’s well-known for everybody, but especially for those who have watched classic western movies. To be more precise - if you have enjoyed the legendary “The Good, The Bad and the Ugly”, you definitely remember Clint Eastwood’s character - “Man with no Name”. The poncho and hat that he wore in this movie became distinctive traits of mysterious, calm, and tough cowboys. And Rose shares these common traits both in her character and in her design choices. 


 Crafting Rose’s color palette

The idea behind Rose’s palette was chosen and crafted intuitively. Rose dives into the Underworld to save her daughter’s soul, and the signature tones of this place are ethereal in dark purple and white colors. Rose’s coloring is really set off by this dark, enigmatic realm. And her palette really captures the mythical essence of the Underworld.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/1e89fc5397d5a1f6e82e1671f3ab020bf6d9019e.png

 What makes Rose.. Rose?

How can we describe Rose in three words? Lightning-quick, badass, but caring. 

She strides in calm, handles her business quietly, and strolls out. You know this type - the ‘cool & collected bounty hunter’. But Rose is hiding something beneath this fierce appearance, either distinctive trait that all mothers share at their core — love. Even though there is little place for love in Rose's world. Her rough and thorny exterior, much like her namesake, meant to keep most others at a distance. However, there is one small thing she holds close to her heart — she is very protective and will do absolutely anything to save her beloved daughter.


 Rose’s arsenal: not just ANY guns

Aside from character traits, Rose is not only a bold bounty-hunter and a loving mother - she is also very good with guns. And when we say good, we mean good. Rose has a trustworthy sidekick - her Underworld-imbued revolver. 
For a cowboy, or in our case, a cowgirl - a revolver is not just a weapon - it’s a lifeline. Rose’s starting revolver is deeply rooted in the real Wild West and inspired by the iconic Colt Peacemaker. Throughout her travels, these weapons resonate with the mysterious power of the Underworld and take on a life of their own. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/18952eb9de9aa31f7ebeccd5cfa7ed333bc97f3d.png

Rose’s revolver is swift to decimate enemy spirits, and reliable enough to stand on its own in tight spots. It complements her speed and determination, summarizing her role as a steady protector and a hair-raising fighter.

As you can see, Rose is a strong and self-assertive character that was inspired by tough cowboy tropes, but has distinctive traits that make her a special and memorable character — fascinating to observe throughout her daring adventure in the Underworld. 

Thank you for taking the time to check out our devlog, we hope you enjoyed getting to know Rose a bit better! In our next devlog we will be diving into the designs of the Underworld and the monstrous creatures that inhabit it. 

Stay tuned and follow us on social media & Discord to stay up-to-date on the latest updates and news!
